scope: Durable host credential publication and remote overlay completion; no new secret authority for Agent or plugins
native: Dedicated ai-api-key.capability-roaming-proof slot and an initially absent synthetic sync master key; no actual user credentials used.
SQLite BEFORE INSERT trigger rejected the first encrypted secret write with db/error. Local value stayed absent and no credential publication occurred.

Removing the trigger allowed first to persist. One preference.changed contained sealed ciphertext, decoded internally to the exact test value. Neither app_kv ciphertext nor event payload contained the synthetic plaintext marker.
BEFORE DELETE rejected deletion with db/error; local first and the one publication remained. Rejected replacement likewise preserved first with no extra event.

A remote-tagged local write changed the credential without echo. Re-overlay from the actual sealed projection failed under a trigger: current remained remote, changed count remained zero, publications stayed one.
After removing the trigger, refresh completed the encrypted local write, restored first, announced exactly one changed-key notification and did not republish it.
Successful deletion produced exactly one null tombstone; final publication labels were first and deleted.
Late body inspection found no raw synthetic SQL failure text. No assertion is made about the earlier transient toast appearance.

Final review added a settled barrier for each remote row so edits accepted between rows cannot be mistaken for durable equality. A fresh native run repeated sealed publication, remote overlay failure/recovery, no echo and cleanup successfully.
unit: Delayed persistence and two queued local values publish the exact committed predecessor, not the newer optimistic snapshot.
Failed write, replacement and deletion publish nothing; remote overlay waits for local persistence and suppresses echo.
Catch-up waits for pending credential rollback and publishes only the surviving durable value.
A pending master-key replacement cannot seal an earlier credential under the uncommitted key; no sync.* secrets enter the event log.
Relay and transport connection setup stop before account adoption/profile activation when their first required credential write fails.
A local write accepted while an earlier remote row is persisting must settle before the next row compares equality; its rollback cannot suppress a needed remote write.
boundaries: Native test drives host functions deterministically; it is not autonomous Agent reasoning, a new plugin composition, or a network relay/cross-device test.
Local credential persistence and roaming event append are still separate transactions. Event append is best-effort; crash/append-failure replay and a durable credential outbox remain open.

Connection setup is not an atomic account/credential/profile transaction. Legacy AI-key adoption, ordinary KV overlay completion, stale projection/local-edit races and all settings UI drafts remain separate gaps.
No packaged/Windows/Linux or complete crypto-file failure matrix is claimed. Existing Rust, bridge and frontend build warnings remain.
